ai_providers.list.title: List AI providers
ai_providers.list.description: Page through the model providers; filter by status, vendor and default, and search code, name and chat model. API keys are never returned.
ai_providers.get.title: Get an AI provider
ai_providers.get.description: Read a model provider's settings; the API key is never returned, only whether one is set.
ai_providers.create.title: Create an AI provider
ai_providers.create.description: Add an OpenAI-compatible model provider. The code is unique and cannot change; the API key is stored encrypted; making it the default clears the previous default.
ai_providers.update.title: Update an AI provider
ai_providers.update.description: Edit a model provider. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one and send back the concurrency stamp you read. New calls use the new settings once the change is committed.
ai_providers.set_status.title: Enable or disable an AI provider
ai_providers.set_status.description: Enable or disable a model provider; disabled providers cannot be used for chat or embeddings. Send back the concurrency stamp you read; a remark replaces the current one.
ai_providers.set_default.title: Set the default AI provider
ai_providers.set_default.description: Make an enabled model provider the default and clear the others; assistants and the knowledge base use it when they name no provider.
ai_providers.delete.title: Delete AI providers
ai_providers.test.title: Test an AI provider
ai_providers.test.description: Send "ping" to the chat model with the current settings and, when an embedding model is set, embed it once and report the dimensions (disabled providers can be tested too). Failures are reported in the result, not as a failed call.
ai.providers.code_taken: An AI provider with code '{code}' already exists.
ai.providers.disabled: AI provider '{code}' is disabled and cannot be made the default.
ai.providers.endpoint_invalid: The endpoint must be an absolute http or https URL.
ai.providers.secret_unreadable: The API key of AI provider '{code}' cannot be decrypted; the data protection keys may have changed. Enter it again.
ai.providers.kind_unavailable: No model provider for the OpenAI-compatible protocol is installed.
openapi.groups.ai.name: AI
openapi.groups.ai.description: Model providers, prompts, the knowledge base and assistants.

openapi.tags.ai_providers.description: OpenAI-compatible model providers: create, read, update and delete, enable or disable, set the default and test the connection. API keys are stored encrypted and never returned.

permissions.ai.ai_providers.read.descrip: View the model providers; API keys are never shown.

permissions.ai.ai_providers.update.name: Update AI providers
permissions.ai.ai_providers.update.descr: Edit, enable, disable and set the default model provider.
